name: Southwest Rapid Rewards® Plus Credit Card

tripDelay.notes: Delay must be 12+ hours or require overnight stay. Up to $500 per ticket.

tripCancellation.notes: Up to $10,000 per person and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable expenses.

lostBaggage.notes: Up to $3,000 per passenger for lost, damaged, or stolen luggage.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for 5 days when bags are delayed 6+ hours.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Up to $500,000 accidental death and dismemberment when traveling on a common carrier.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services: 24/7 referral services. Does not cover medical costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental CDW when you decline the rental company's collision coverage.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers new purchases for 120 days — up to $500 per claim.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extends the U.S. manufacturer's warranty by 1 additional year on eligible warranties of 3 years or less.

rewards.hotelRate: 2x points on hotel and car rental partners
rewards.diningRate: 2x points at restaurants and food delivery services
rewards.internetPhoneCableRate: 2x points on internet, cable, and phone services
otherBonusCategories: 2x points on local transit and commuting (including rideshare)

annualCredits.name: Anniversary Bonus Points
annualCredits.notes: 3,000 bonus Rapid Rewards points each card anniversary year.

freeCheckedBags.notes: Southwest already allows 2 free checked bags for all passengers — no additional benefit needed.

priorityBoarding.notes: No upgraded boarding benefit on the Plus card.

companionPass.notes: Earn the Southwest Companion Pass by accumulating 135,000 Rapid Rewards points in a calendar year. Companion flies free (just taxes/fees) for remainder of year + following full year.

eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Card purchases earn tier qualifying points toward A-List and A-List Preferred status.

travelPerks: 2x points on dining, streaming, and transit
Path to Southwest Companion Pass (135,000 points in a year)
bestFor: Southwest beginners or casual flyers who want the entry-level card to earn Rapid Rewards points and work toward the Companion Pass
